Role Overview: We're seeking a motivated entry-level AI Engineer to join our AI team. You’ll help build LLM-powered applications and autonomous AI agents that go into the customized software we deliver for clients across financial services, insurance, telecom, retail, and utilities.

The role is hands-on, involving turning business problems into working AI features such as retrieval-augmented applications, document-processing systems, and multi-step agents, and getting them into production alongside our senior engineers. It’s a strong opportunity for a recent graduate to build real AI engineering experience on live client projects.


Key Responsibilities:

LLM Application Development

  • Prompt Engineering: Develop and iterate on prompting strategies for reliable, task-specific outputs.

  • LLM Integration: Build applications on top of large language models for document processing, customer support automation, and financial analysis.

  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG): Assist in building RAG pipelines which includes chunking, embeddings, vector search, and grounding responses in client data.

  • Evaluation & Guardrails: Help test LLM outputs for accuracy and safety, and apply basic guardrails such as PII handling, prompt-injection checks, and output validation.

Agentic AI Development

  • Agent Development: Learn to build autonomous and multi-agent systems that plan and execute multi-step tasks.

  • Tool Integration: Create and integrate tools and APIs that agents use to interact with external systems.

  • Orchestration: Work with agent frameworks and orchestration tooling to compose reliable agent workflows.

Model Development

  • Model Development: Assist in training, fine-tuning, and optimizing machine learning models for classification, regression, and NLP tasks.

  • Model Evaluation: Support evaluation of model performance and help interpret results.

  • Data Preparation: Prepare and curate datasets for training and evaluation, including labeling, cleaning, and formatting.

AI Application Engineering

  • Python Development: Build Python applications, microservices, and APIs that serve AI models and agents.

  • Deployment Support: Support deployment of AI applications to production, including basic CI/CD and containerized workflows.

  • Monitoring: Help set up monitoring and alerting for model performance and application health.


Cross-Functional Responsibilities

  • Research & Development: Keep current with AI/ML and agent developments; experiment with new models, frameworks, and techniques.

  • Collaboration: Work with senior engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to identify and shape AI opportunities.

  • Documentation: Document prompts, agent designs, model architectures, and runbooks so others can build on your work.


Required Qualifications:

  • Education: Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Computing, Software Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field. Recent graduates are welcomed.

  • Academic Foundation: Coursework in machine learning, statistics, data structures, and algorithms.

  • Programming Skills: Proficiency in Python and working knowledge of SQL, with academic or personal project experience.

  • ML Foundation: Understanding of core machine learning concepts and how models are trained and evaluated.

  • LLM Curiosity: Genuine interest in large language models, prompting, and building applications on top of them.

  • Learning Mindset: Strong desire to learn AI engineering and agent frameworks, with the adaptability to pick up new tools quickly.

  • Problem Solving: Analytical thinking and a systematic approach to AI and data problems.

  • Communication: Good written and verbal communication for collaborative work and stakeholder discussions.


Preferred Qualifications

  • LLM Experience: Personal projects, coursework, or internship experience building with LLMs (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI, or open models).

  • Agent Development: Familiarity with agent frameworks such as Strands and LangChain, and orchestration with LangGraph.

  • RAG & Vector Search: Exposure to embeddings and vector databases such as OpenSearch, pgvector, or FAISS.

  • Deep Learning Frameworks: Academic projects using PyTorch or TensorFlow.

  • Data Science Libraries: Experience with Pandas and NumPy.

  • Cloud Exposure: Basic familiarity with AWS (preferred), GCP, or Azure, and with cloud AI services such as Amazon Bedrock.

  • Containers & Version Control: Working knowledge of Docker and Git.

  • Databases: Experience with SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB) databases.

Role Overview

As an AI Infrastructure Engineer, you will be responsible for the end-to-end deployment of on-premise AI solutions. This role is a unique blend of high-performance hardware engineering and software stack orchestration. You will be the driving force behind the physical assembly of high-performance computing hardware, operating system provisioning, and the deployment of containerized AI applications.

You will serve as the primary technical point of contact for ensuring system reliability and performance at client sites, bridging the gap between raw silicon and production-ready AI models.

  • Systems Integration: Perform full-cycle hardware assembly, including the integration of high-performance Motherboards (MB), CPUs, GPUs, and high-speed NVMe/SSD storage arrays.

  • Logistics & Hardware Management: Oversee the end-to-end logistics lifecycle of hardware assets, including inventory tracking, shipping, and coordinated onsite installation to ensure seamless customer delivery.

  • Deployment & Maintenance: Provision and configure Linux-based environments and specialized AI software stacks on-premise, ensuring environments are tuned for heavy compute.

  • System Diagnostics: Monitor system health and perform deep-dive debugging by analyzing Docker logs, kernel logs (dmesg), and hardware telemetry to preempt failures.

  • Collaborative Troubleshooting: Isolate and resolve complex network configurations, driver conflicts (NVIDIA/CUDA), and hardware-level failures.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience: 1–2 years in infrastructure support, system administration, or similar roles. Fresh graduates with strong Linux and "homelab" infrastructure knowledge are encouraged to apply.

  • Hardware Proficiency: Deep understanding of PC/Server architecture, including CPU architectures, GPU power requirements, PCIe lane distribution, and DRAM/Storage scaling.

  • OS & Scripting: Strong command of the Linux CLI (Ubuntu/CentOS) for filesystem management, networking configuration, and shell scripting for task automation.

  • Containerization: Practical experience managing Docker environments and understanding container lifecycles.

  • Precision & Detail: High level of precision in physical assembly, including cable management, thermal application, and firmware/BIOS updates.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Orchestration: Basic understanding of Kubernetes or other container orchestration platforms.

  • NVIDIA Stack: Familiarity with the NVIDIA AI Enterprise stack and GPU operator deployments.

  • Communication: Ability to translate complex technical issues into clear status reports for both internal engineering teams and non-technical client stakeholders.

· 5+ years of hands-on UI/product design experience for software products, preferably B2B SaaS, enterprise dashboards, AI products, or data-heavy applications.

· Strong Figma skills, including component libraries, auto layout, variants, prototyping, handoff specs, and design system maintenance.

· A strong portfolio demonstrating visual design quality, interaction logic, information architecture, and the ability to simplify complex workflows.

· Good understanding of frontend basics such as HTML, CSS, responsive layout, component-based UI, and design-to-development handoff. You do not need to be a production frontend engineer.

· Practical use of AI tools for UI exploration, prototyping, UX writing, or frontend draft generation, such as Figma Make, v0, Lovable, Bolt.new, Replit, Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar tools.

· Strong English communication and UI writing ability; able to make interface text concise, professional, and user-friendly for Malaysian and ASEAN users.

· Ability to work in an ambiguous, startup-like environment, iterate quickly, and balance speed with design quality.

· User-centered mindset and sensitivity to local culture, business etiquette, and English-language product experience in Malaysia and Southeast Asia.

WHAT YOU CAN LEARN HERE

· AI-native design workflows where product specs, UI prototypes, and AI-assisted frontend drafts form a tight feedback loop.

· How LLMs, RAG, and AI agent workflows affect interface design, trust, explainability, confidence indicators, and human-in-the-loop controls.

· Design-to-code workflows with AI tools, including prompt patterns, design system integration, prototype validation, and engineering review gates.

· Multi-market localization strategies for Southeast Asia, especially adapting China-origin products to ASEAN users.

· Domain knowledge in AI+Energy and AI+Education products.

· Responsible AI UX, privacy-aware design, and ASEAN regulatory context such as Malaysia PDPA.

LANGUAGE

Proficiency in English is essential. Proficiency in Chinese (Mandarin) is strongly preferred. Malay is a plus for on-site work and local coordination.

WHY JOIN US

· Founding design owner opportunity: shape the user experience, design system, and localization standards of a brand-new AI R&D center from the ground up.

· Build real AI products for energy and education across Malaysia and Southeast Asia.

· Work in an AI-first team where PM specs, UI prototypes, and engineering implementation are tightly connected.

· High-impact role: your UI decisions will directly affect whether mature China products can be successfully adopted by local users.

· 3-year strategic incubation: no short-term revenue pressure. Focus on building the right products, product language, and design culture.

You will help bridge China's mature product logic with Malaysia's local user experience. Your success is not measured by how much production code you write, but by how quickly and clearly the team can turn product ideas into interfaces that users understand, trust, and want to use.

We expect our engineers to develop a good understanding of the problems they are solving. You will therefore be expected to learn about the market research and consulting domain, work closely with our business stakeholders, and understand their workflows, challenges, and client needs. We believe that understanding the domain is essential to building genuinely useful AI applications rather than simply applying technology to a problem.

This role involves working with global stakeholders across different time zones. From time to time, you may be required to attend meetings outside your normal working hours. We support flexible working arrangements, allowing you to adjust your working hours accordingly when this is needed.

We are the world's leading market intelligence agency and technology underpins our success. We help our clients understand consumers and consumer markets, and we aspire to provide the market intelligence behind every great business decision. Our technology allows us to deliver data, insights, and opinions in a compelling way to our clients across the globe.

Mintel is committed to building and supporting a diverse workforce, providing opportunities for all. 22% of our Engineering team and 23% of our Engineering leaders are women. We offer flexible working options and provide support, development and growth opportunities.

  • A good foundation in system design and software architecture, with an understanding of areas such as API design, data flows, application boundaries, scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability.
  • Exposure to DevOps and cloud environments, including areas such as application deployment, CI/CD, monitoring, logging, and debugging production issues. Hands-on AWS experience is particularly valuable.

The Malaysia AI Innovation Center is the overseas R&D hub of our AI Business Group, localizing and scaling AI products across ASEAN markets. We are looking for a Product Manager who works at the intersection of two dimensions:

First, you are a Product Manager for AI products — you own the lifecycle of AI-powered solutions (intelligent agents, AI+industry platforms), translating real business pain points into clear product strategies, roadmaps, and delivery milestones.

Second, you are a Product Manager powered by AI — you use AI tools as core instruments of your own craft. Whether it’s using LLMs for market research, building rapid prototypes with AI generation tools, or writing specifications clear enough for both humans and AI agents to execute, AI is how you work, not just what you build.

You don’t need to be a deep technical expert. What matters is that you understand AI’s practical capabilities and limitations, communicate precisely with engineering teams, and care deeply about solving real customer problems.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Business Insight: Deeply understand industry clients and regional customers’ business pain points. Identify where AI can create meaningful value, recommend practical technology approaches, and drive the integration of AI capabilities with existing business systems.

• AI Technical Understanding: Maintain a working understanding of how large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and AI agent architectures function. You don’t need to build these systems, but you need to assess what AI can and cannot do reliably, evaluate feasibility and cost, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.

• AI Product Design: Translate customer requirements into clear AI product definitions. Lead product planning from zero to one: iteration roadmaps, delivery milestones, and prioritization of features. Produce clear PRDs, specification documents, and usage guidelines that both human developers and AI tools can work from.

• AI Product Solution Design: Design end-to-end product solutions integrated with customer business workflows. Package successful solutions into reusable templates and frameworks. Serve as the bridge between engineering (technical details) and business teams (value outcomes).

• Team Collaboration & Project Delivery: Coordinate across R&D, design, testing, delivery, and operations teams. Drive the full cycle from prototype review through internal testing, pilot rollout, and optimization. Translate business requirements into language engineers can act on, and resolve issues as they arise.

WHAT YOU MUST BRING

• 5+ years of software product management experience, with a track record of guiding products from discovery through delivery.

• Practical understanding of how LLMs work — you know what a context window is, why AI outputs can be inconsistent, and how to write clear instructions that get reliable results from AI tools.

• Strong analytical mindset with a passion for user-centric design and the ability to balance speed with quality.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to articulate precise requirements to both human teams and AI systems.

WHAT YOU CAN LEARN HERE

We will invest in your growth in these areas. Prior exposure is a plus, not a prerequisite:

• Specification-driven development practices — writing machine-parseable specs that directly drive AI agent execution.

• Hands-on use of AI prototyping tools (Lovable, Bolt.new, v0, Replit) for rapid MVP development.

• AI safety principles, responsible AI practices, and ASEAN regulatory frameworks (Malaysia PDPA).

• Multi-market product localization strategies for Southeast Asian markets.

LANGUAGE

Proficiency in Chinese is valued for day-to-day collaboration with our China headquarters. Candidates without speaking Chinese who demonstrate strong cross-cultural communication skills are equally welcome.

WHY JOIN US

• Founding team opportunity: you will shape the product culture and strategy of a brand-new R&D center from the ground up.

• Own the full product lifecycle for AI-powered solutions serving real industries — energy and education — across a fast-growing ASEAN market.

• AI-first team culture: your specifications will directly drive AI coding agents, giving you a uniquely tight feedback loop between what you define and what gets built.

• 3-year strategic incubation: no short-term revenue pressure. Focus on building the right products and learning cutting-edge AI product practices.

You will form the leadership duo alongside the Senior Software Engineer (Architecture Track), jointly building the Center’s team. In Year 1, you’ll work with a compact team of 5–15 people, scaling to 25–30 by Year 2. You’ll collaborate daily with the technical lead on translating product specs into implementation, and work closely with domestic business units (AI+Energy, AI+Education) to localize mature products for ASEAN markets.
